#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 99999999;

void solve() {
    int n, K;
    scanf("%d %d", &n, &K);
    vector<vector<int>> ts(K, vector<int>(2));
    long long all = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        scanf("%d %d", &ts[i][0], &ts[i][1]);
        all += ts[i][1] - ts[i][0];
    }
    vector<int> dpe(n + 1, INF);
    vector<int> dpo(n + 1, INF);
    if (ts[0][0] > n) {
        printf("Hungry\n");
        return;
    }
    dpe[ts[0][0]] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        vector<int> ndpo(n + 1, INF);
        vector<int> ndpe(n + 1, INF);
        deque<int> dq;
        int w = ts[i][1] - ts[i][0];
        // Process dpe deque
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            while (!dq.empty() && dpe[dq.back()] >= dpe[j]) dq.pop_back();
            while (!dq.empty() && dq.front() < j - w) dq.pop_front();
            dq.push_back(j);
            ndpo[j] = min(ndpo[j], dpe[dq.front()] + 1);
            if (j + w <= n) ndpe[j + w] = min(ndpe[j + w], dpe[j]);
        }
        dq.clear();
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            while (!dq.empty() && dpo[dq.back()] >= dpo[j]) dq.pop_back();
            while (!dq.empty() && dq.front() < j - w) dq.pop_front();
            dq.push_back(j);
            ndpe[j] = min(ndpe[j], dpo[dq.front()] + 1);
            ndpo[j] = min(ndpo[j], dpo[j]);
        }
        dpo = ndpo;
        dpe = ndpe;
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            dpe[j] = min(dpe[j], dpo[j] + 1);
            dpo[j] = min(dpo[j], dpe[j] + 1);
        }
        int s = (i == K - 1 ? 2 * n : ts[i + 1][0]) - ts[i][1];
        if (s > 0) {
            // shift dpe by s to the right
            memmove(&dpe[s], &dpe[0], (n - s + 1) * sizeof(int));
            fill(dpe.begin(), dpe.begin() + min(n, s - 1) + 1, INF);
        }
    }
    int ans = min(dpe[n], dpo[n]);
    if (ans >= 9999999) {
        printf("Hungry\n");
    } else {
        printf("Full\n%d\n", ans);
    }
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
